Name: ZH's Fancy Grub - Roasting Marshmallow
Author: ZoeyHoshi
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/qyepvC5.png[/img][/center]
﻿
Another add-on of my Fancy Grub series which simply retextures cooked dishes, but this time it's retexturing everything from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/18901754]aedenthorn[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36368]Roasting Marshmallows[/url]. I wanted to make something that fit along with [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/mrtaiyou?gameId=1303]Tai[/url]'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21437]Vanilla Tweaks[/url] mods or [url=https://next.nexusmods.com/profile/birDfiSHi?gameId=1303]DSHi[/url]﻿'s [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/18726]Retexture[/url] mods but I didn't want to make something that just copied their style, so I tried my best to create something that could work alongside their work.

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/U2xyWPu.png[/img]﻿[/center]
This mod, like my others, is completely [i]configurable[/i]. Anything you don't like or want, you can simply disable

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/3SSYWRW.png[/img]﻿﻿[/center]
1. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url]﻿
2. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/36368]Roasting Marshmallows[/url]﻿.﻿
3. Install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for easy configurations
4. Download the main .zip file from this mod and install it
5. When starting the game for the first time since installing, use Generic Mod Config Menu to configure the mod to your liking

You're all done and ready to play

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mTUL7Ne.png[/img][/center]
